offering_description.value: Designs, builds and sells entry-level single-family homes to individual homebuyers. Uses an asset-light model of buying finished lots and building with subcontractors. Also offers mortgage, title and insurance services through affiliated businesses.

primary_services.value: mortgage financing; title and closing services; homeowners insurance brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2C: first-time and entry-level individual homebuyers

revenue_model.value: product sales: home sales to buyers at closing; service fees: mortgage origination, title and closing fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds homes on purchased finished lots using subcontracted labor and purchased materials, sold to homebuyers; financial intermediary: mortgage and title services to its homebuyers via affiliates

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeast and Texas markets including Atlanta, Birmingham, Nashville, Charlotte, Greenville, Houston, Dallas and Florida

specialization.value: related lines: entry-level homebuilding with mortgage, title and insurance services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: on-site sales staff at community model homes; agents / brokers: third-party real estate agents bringing buyers; online: website lead generation and home browsing

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: land use, zoning, building codes, environmental rules, and mortgage lending regulations such as CFPB

notes: Exact market list and mortgage affiliate structure are approximate.
